thread:
elaine (docs): Heads-up: the /v1/rerank API example in API reference still shows queries as a single string. We removed auto-wrapping; docs need to show an array of query objects. Opening small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3160
matt (eng): Confirmed. Runtime expects queries: [{ query: string, top_k?: number }]. Please do not show the legacy single-string form.
nina (sdk): Will update JS/TS SDK snippets and types after docs are fixed. Current types allow legacy union; I'll tighten to the object-array and add a migration note.
jordan (api): Add a migration callout: "Deprecated: single-string queries were auto-wrapped previously; now send an array of query objects. Results align to queries via query_index." Also note documents may be strings or objects (e.g., {id,text}).
elaine (docs): Can someone paste a concise corrected curl + example response I can drop into the PR?
matt (eng): Use this minimal curl example and response:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rerank-large-v1","queries":[{"query":"Where is tokenization documented?","top_k":5},{"query":"Dedicated setup?","top_k":3}],"documents":["Doc A text","Doc B text","Doc C text"] }'

Example response (abridged): {"results":[{"query_index":0,"document_indices":[0,2],"scores":[0.97,0.65]},{"query_index":1,"document_indices":[2,0],"scores":[0.88,0.40]}]}
nina (sdk): Thanks, will reference docs PR 3160 from SDK PR and include migration note in changelog.
ci-bot: docs build for PR 3160 passed  https://ci.redwood.ai/3160/builds/7 
elaine (docs): Patch pushed: updated examples, added migration callout and note on per-doc metadata. Merging after quick proofread. Thanks!
